Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 07-Jan-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. END SEMESTER DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2124/ECE_2124 - DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN  
  (MAKEUP)  
  
  
  DIGITAL SYSTEM DESIGN [ECE 2124]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Design a combinational circuit to convert 4-bit Binary to Gray code.                                 (4)  
1B)                Design the specified Boolean function using 8:1 multiplexer, where D is the input and A, B, C are    (3)  
  utilized as the selection lines.  
  $$F(A,B,C,D) = AB' + BD + B'CD'$$  
1C)                Implement 4 to 16 decoder using 2 to 4 decoder using optimized number of decoders.                   (3)  
2A)                Design a 2-bit magnitude comparator using basic logic gates.                                         (4)  
2B)                Design a mod-6 ripple up counter using negative edge triggered T Flipflops with active high clear.   (3)  
2C)                Design a synchronous 3-bit Gray code counter using positive edge triggered T flipflops.              (3)  
3A)                Design sequence detector to detect the overlapping sequence 0101 using Mealy model with              (4)  
  positive edge triggered D Flipflop.  
3B)                Convert D flipflop to JK flipflop. Write characteristic equations of JK flip flop.                   (3)  
3C)                Write a structural Verilog for the circuit shown in Fig 3C.                                          (3)  
  
  
4A)                Write a behavioral Verilog code for 2 bit comparator using if else statement.                        (4)  
4B)                Write a dataflow Verilog code for 2:4 decoder                                                        (3)  
4C)                Write a Verilog code for a 3 input XOR gate using user defined primitive (UDP)                       (3)  
5A)                Implement full adder using ACT 1 logic module                                                        (4)  
5B)                Explain ASIC design flow with neat diagram                                                           (3)  
5C)                What is TTL logic? Explain the working of 2 input NAND gate using TTL logic                          (3)  
  
  
  -----End-----
